sloka: ततः शोकेन सम्वीतः पितुर् मरण दुह्खितः ।विललाप महा तेजा भ्रान्त आकुलित चेतनः ॥२-७२-१८॥
transliteration: tataḥ śokena samvītaḥ pitur maraṇa duhkhitaḥ ।vilalāpa mahā tejā bhrānta ākulita cetanaḥ ॥2-72-18॥

translations.english: Overwhelmed with grief, radiant Bharata reeling with delusion due to sorrow, lamented over the death of his father.
